items.t: American Express (AXP) Names Sarah Dodds Brown As Legal Chief After Laureen Seeger Retirement
items.sum: American Express (NYSE:AXP) announced a leadership change as Chief Legal Officer Laureen Seeger retires after a long tenure. Sarah Dodds-Brown has been appointed to succeed Seeger as Chief Legal Officer, overseeing legal and governance functions. The transition shifts responsibility for legal, regulatory and governance matters from Seeger to Dodds-Brown within the American Express executive team.
